svg.title: Five months, four steps, no zero-day
svg.desc: The Binance attack in four steps. June 2026: a wallet engineer downloads a tampered Homebrew installer while looking for an AI coding tool. September 2026: a second engineer is recruited through a fake LinkedIn job interview and runs a malicious take-home assignment. 20 October 2026: attackers use Binance's own internal AI tools to take over two more wallet engineers' machines. 29 October 2026: an EIP-7702 authorization gives a malicious contract partial control of a hot wallet and about 6.3 billion dollars leaves in roughly 20 minutes.
svg.text: Five months, four steps, no zero-day
The Binance attack, per its 3 Nov 2026 incident report
JUNE 2026
AI as bait
The lure
A wallet engineer downloads a tampered Homebrew
installer while looking for an AI coding tool.
SEPTEMBER 2026
The interview
A second engineer is approached on LinkedIn. A fake
HR call, a fake CEO call, then a malicious take-home
assignment that infects his work laptop.
20 OCTOBER 2026
AI as the pivot
The pivot
From that laptop the attackers use Binance's own
internal AI tools to take over two more wallet
engineers' machines.
29 OCTOBER 2026
The drain
An EIP-7702 authorization gives a malicious contract
partial control of a hot wallet. About $6.3 billion
leaves in roughly 20 minutes.
Binance hasn't said how the internal AI tool was misused.
Sources: Binance report via Fortune, NBC, Security Affairs.
